newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cintas rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cintas rating cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it lowered its intermediate six-month rating on Cintas Corp to underperform from market performer based on price only. It said internal growth is still in the 15 percent range.
-- EPS estimates remain at $1.90 for the fiscal year ending May 1997.
-- The stock is selling at nearly a 70 percent premium to the S&P 500 on calendar 1997 estimated earnings, which is at the high end of the historic range, EVEREN said in a report.
